headline: High-risk shared-workspace orchestration: Langflow can write and execute server-side code, while LightZero is read-only and non-networked, so the main hazards are prompt injection, leakage, and cascading errors through shared flow state.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Langflow can ingest uploaded files and arbitrary HTTP content into flows, and its graph-based flows can chain multiple agents; if LightZero outputs are routed into Langflow nodes, attacker-controlled content could be treated as instructions. LightZero itself has no ingestion surfaces, so the pathway is one-way from Langflow-side inputs, but the shared flow/server state makes injection plausible.
conditions: IF LightZero outputs are copied into a Langflow node that parses text as instructions
IF Langflow flows fetch untrusted HTTP content and pass it to downstream agents
mitigations: Add a strict delimiter and schema check before any text from LightZero enters Langflow
Disable free-form instruction parsing on Langflow nodes handling external content
Use a human review step for any prompt-like content before execution
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to every inter-agent message

B_data_leakage.rationale: Langflow touches flow inputs, intermediate outputs, uploaded files, and stored credentials, while LightZero touches no data classes and has no filesystem or network surfaces. If both run in a shared workspace or server-side store, Langflow can expose sensitive flow artifacts to the pair even though LightZero itself is not a leak source.
conditions: IF Langflow and LightZero share the same server-side workspace or storage backend
IF uploaded files or flow inputs contain sensitive data
mitigations: Separate workspaces and storage buckets for the two agents
Remove sensitive files from Langflow uploads before running paired flows
Rotate any Langflow-stored credentials after the run
Restrict access to the shared server filesystem to the minimum operator group

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Langflow has shell, package-install, subprocess, and filesystem-write capabilities, but LightZero has none of those and cannot modify shared state. There is no overlapping write surface in the profiles, so direct capability conflict is limited unless the deployment adds an external shared mutable resource not shown here.
conditions: IF an external shared directory or database is added outside the profiles
IF Langflow flows are configured to write into a path also used by another process
mitigations: Keep LightZero read-only in the paired deployment
Point Langflow writes at an isolated directory
Avoid concurrent writes from multiple Langflow instances to the same path
requires-engineering: add file locks for any shared mutable resource

D_cascading_error.rationale: Langflow can chain multiple agents and execute server-side Python, so if LightZero outputs are fed into a Langflow flow without verification, Langflow may treat them as authoritative and act on them. LightZero is not an action-taking agent, but its outputs can still become unverified inputs to Langflow, creating a realistic cascade.
conditions: IF LightZero outputs are used as inputs to a Langflow flow without validation
IF Langflow nodes trigger downstream actions based on those outputs
mitigations: Insert a verification step between LightZero output and Langflow action nodes
Require structured output from LightZero before Langflow consumes it
Log and review any Langflow action triggered by LightZero-derived text
requires-engineering: add confidence thresholds before downstream execution

E_compliance.rationale: Langflow stores per-flow credentials and processes flow inputs/intermediate outputs, while LightZero is a game-playing package with no declared data classes or residency constraints. The pair does not show a direct residency or regulated-data mismatch, but Langflow’s storage and logging create a small compliance gap if sensitive flow data is introduced.
conditions: IF regulated data is entered into Langflow flows
IF Langflow storage or logs retain that regulated data
mitigations: Avoid placing regulated data into Langflow flows
Purge flow logs after the run
Store credentials outside the default Langflow store where possible
Document retention settings for the shared deployment
